-- Creating Master Key
-- CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = ''

-- Create Credential
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL noorcreds
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

-- CREATING EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE with raw container

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://raw@storagesynapselearning.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = noorcreds
)

-- CREATING EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE with enriched container

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE enriched_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://enriched@storagesynapselearning.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = noorcreds
)

-- Creating external file format parquet
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)
